High DEP02-B lots came from both clean tools, with LOT-1214 from CLN01 at 513.01 and LOT-1236 from CLN02 at 516.06

disposition.summary: DEP02-B came back from PM running high, with three consecutive thick lots. Other chambers read normal on the same metrology tool and high lots span both clean tools, so the chamber is at fault. Hold the alarm lot and the chamber.
